title: Bayteh tan sumaaqitte
intro: Taturte dabaanitteh addat, ayyunti saltaneetitteh fanat yan gitih addat suge. ken nabiyyi numma gita fan ken seece, uxih oson kufri kee zulmit yibbixsiisen. Tama aydaadi yallih digaalal gaba kala. Atu ta agat kee ken sarrimaane gubal tan rortittek baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Ummatta isi farmoytiitiy num bahte maabitina cinteh.
farmoyti inki yalla akah taabudennah nee seeceeh, umaadobik diggosna.
Ni qellat nek fanal ruube farmoyti numma luk cineenih sugen.
Nanu farmoyti reeda dareemu hayneh duquurusiyyal kaa malkisne.
Nanu ninni buxaaxil amaanat luk sugne way digaala nee gufte.
Nanu ninni farmoytit dirabneeh, mu'miniinit qanxisneemih taagah finqinno.
arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
